issues.issue: Game loop crashed every frame when no AudioContext existed (demo, guest joining by link without tapping): canvas froze, end screen not sent to the guest.
issues.fix: All synth paths guard a missing AudioContext; every effect handler is wrapped so a cosmetic failure can never stop the simulation or rendering. Regression test added.

issues.issue: If the host reloaded/closed, the guest waited on 'Reconnecting…' for a room that no longer existed.
issues.fix: Both pages send a goodbye on page unload; the guest also treats repeated 'peer unavailable' from the broker as 'The host left the game' with a Main menu button. Tested with local and real PeerJS (incl. a silent host crash).

issues.issue: 3 stars nearly unreachable and dependent on an opaque score bar.
issues.fix: Stars are now kid-readable and skill-based: 2★ = clear taking 4 hits or fewer, 3★ = flawless clear (no hits) under 7:05. Rules shown on the Survival card and on the end screen ('You took N hits…'). Strong pairs get 3★ in ~7% of runs.

issues.issue: Endless difficulty spiked right after the first boss.
issues.fix: The wave after every boss is a breather (55% budget).

issues.issue: 'Skip tutorial' sat in Player 2's thumb zone.
issues.fix: Moved to the top bar beside Pause; 48 px tall buttons.

issues.issue: Tutorial said 'That costs a life' but didn't; lives hidden in tutorial.
issues.fix: Text now 'In a real game that costs a life'; hearts shown during the tutorial.

issues.issue: Tutorial never taught Link capsules; active power-up chip had no name.
issues.fix: New tutorial step: both orbs stand in a capsule ring. HUD chips show the power name and seconds left.

issues.issue: Spitter (diamond) resembled Player 2's diamond.
issues.fix: Spitter redrawn as a round turret with feet, a barrel and an eye.

issues.issue: Enemy shots hard to see among pink enemies.
issues.fix: Shots now have a white-hot core, dark ring, bright rim and a trail.

issues.issue: Spikes under text outlines (miter joins).
issues.fix: Round line joins for all outlined text.

issues.issue: HUD and HUD buttons showed through dialogs.
issues.fix: HUD and in-game buttons hidden under any dialog; overlays more opaque.

issues.issue: Endless end screen could say 'Best wave 0'.
issues.fix: Best wave shown only when meaningful.

issues.issue: Wave 1 punished players who hadn't started moving.
issues.fix: Until anyone moves, wave-1 enemies move at half speed; wave 1 also tightened (less idle time).

issues.issue: Drop screens: 'Keep waiting' shown during the countdown, stale pause text, a lingering '0'.
issues.fix: Only 'Main menu' during the countdown; after it, 'Keep waiting' appears and the 0 becomes a sentence. A guest closing the tab drops immediately (goodbye message).

issues.issue: 'How to play' dropped players straight into a Survival run.
issues.fix: It now ends on a 'You've got it!' screen: Play Survival / Main menu.

issues.issue: No keyboard pause.
issues.fix: Esc / P pause and resume.

issues.issue: Buttons under 48 px.
issues.fix: In-game buttons 52×48 px, inside safe-area insets.

issues.issue: 4:3 tablets letterbox the 2:1 arena; HUD far from the action.
issues.fix: HUD now sits just above the arena on tall screens. The arena stays 2:1 on purpose so both phones in an online game see the same world.

issues.issue: Guest's view of the host orb occasionally stuttered.
issues.fix: Snapshots 20→25 Hz and interpolation delay 100→120 ms.

issues.issue: Attract demo distracted behind the title text.
issues.fix: Darker veil over the demo.

issues.issue: Score had no label; showed '0' during the tutorial.
issues.fix: Small SCORE caption; score hidden during the tutorial.

issues.issue: Host link field cut off the code.
issues.fix: Field scrolls to show the end of the link (the code).

issues.issue: No settings in the pause menu.
issues.fix: Settings button in Pause (shake applies immediately; Assist applies from the next game, labelled).

issues.issue: Boss can feel short for expert teams (~20–35 s).
issues.fix: Kept by design: average pairs need ~70 s and only clear 35% overall; lengthening it would push average pairs below the 30% target. Noted as a candidate for a future 'Hard' mode.

rerun: After the fixes the full simulation was rerun (1,200 runs). All targets still hold — see section 11 (those are the post-review numbers).
